title: Foundations Module 1 MCQ Test
description: Module: Foundations · Duration: 50 minutes (2 minutes per question) · Questions: 25 · Level: Difficult

questions.prompt: If $\alpha$ and $\beta$ are roots of $x^2 - 3x + 1 = 0$, then $\alpha^4 + \beta^4$ equals
questions.explanation: Using $\alpha+\beta=3$, $\alpha\beta=1$: $\alpha^2+\beta^2=(\alpha+\beta)^2-2\alpha\beta=7$. Then $\alpha^4+\beta^4=(\alpha^2+\beta^2)^2-2\alpha^2\beta^2=49-2=47.

questions.prompt: The number of real solutions of $|x^2 - 3x| + |x - 1| = 3$ is
questions.explanation: Split at $x=0,1,3$ and solve on each piece; the three real roots are $2-\sqrt{6}$, $2$, and $1+\sqrt{5}$ giving 3 solutions.

questions.prompt: The solution set of $\dfrac{x^2 - 5x + 6}{x^2 - 4} \leq 0$ is
questions.explanation: For $x\neq\pm2$ the fraction reduces to $\dfrac{x-3}{x+2}\le 0$ so $x\in(-2,3]\setminus\{2\}=(-2,2)\cup(2,3]$.

questions.prompt: If $\log_2(x-1) + \log_2(x+3) = 3$, then $x$ equals
questions.explanation: Domain $x>1$. Multiply: $(x-1)(x+3)=8\Rightarrow x^2+2x-11=0\Rightarrow x=-1\pm 2\sqrt{3}$. Only $-1+2\sqrt{3}>1$.

If $9^x - 3^{x+1} - 54 = 0$, then $x$ equals
questions.explanation: Put $t=3^x>0$: $t^2-3t-54=0\Rightarrow (t-9)(t+6)=0\Rightarrow t=9\Rightarrow x=2$.

questions.prompt: The set of all real $a$ for which both roots of $x^2 - 2ax + (a^2 - 1) = 0$ are positive is
questions.explanation: Roots are $a\pm 1$. Need both positive: $a-1>0$ and $a+1>0$, so $a>1$.

questions.prompt: Let $S = \sum_{k=2}^{9} \dfrac{1}{\log_k \pi}$. Then $S$ lies in
questions.explanation: $S=\sum_{k=2}^{9}\log_\pi k=\log_\pi(2\cdot3\cdots9)=\log_\pi(9!)=\dfrac{\ln 9!}{\ln\pi}\approx 11.18\in(11,12).

questions.prompt: If $\sin x + \sin^2 x = 1$, then $\cos^{12} x + 3\cos^{10} x + 3\cos^8 x + \cos^6 x$ equals
questions.explanation: From $\sin x+\sin^2 x=1$ we get $\cos^2 x=\sin x$ and $\cos^2 x(1+\cos^2 x)=1$. Expression equals $(\cos^2(1+\cos^2))^3=1^3=1$.

questions.prompt: The number of solutions of $\sin 5x = \sin 3x$ in the open interval $(0,\pi)$ is
questions.explanation: $\sin5x=\sin3x$ gives $x=n\pi$ or $x=\dfrac{(2n+1)\pi}{8}$. In $(0,\pi)$ the four values $\dfrac{\pi}{8},\dfrac{3\pi}{8},\dfrac{5\pi}{8},\dfrac{7\pi}{8}$.

questions.prompt: The range of $f(x) = \sin^2 x + \sin x + 1$ ($x \in \mathbb{R}$) is
questions.explanation: Let $u=\sin x\in[-1,1]$. Then $g(u)=u^2+u+1$ has minimum at $u=-1/2$ with $g=3/4$ and maximum $g(1)=3$. So range $[3/4,3]$.

questions.prompt: The general solution of $\sqrt{3}\,\sin x - \cos x = \sqrt{2}$ is
questions.explanation: Rewrite: $\sqrt{3}\sin x-\cos x=2\sin(x-\pi/6)=\sqrt{2}$. So $\sin(x-\pi/6)=\sqrt{2}/2$, giving $x=2n\pi+5\pi/12$ or $2n\pi+11\pi/12$.

questions.prompt: Let $\alpha = \tan^{-1}\dfrac{1}{2}$ and $\beta = \tan^{-1}\dfrac{1}{3}$. Then $\sin\bigl(2(\alpha+\beta)\bigr)$ equals
questions.explanation: Compute $\tan(\alpha+\beta)=\dfrac{1/2+1/3}{1-(1/2)(1/3)}=1$ with $\alpha+\beta\in(0,\pi/2)$ so $\alpha+\beta=\pi/4$. Then $\sin(2(\alpha+\beta))=\sin(\pi/2)=1$.

questions.prompt: $\sin^{-1}\!\left(\sin\dfrac{8\pi}{5}\right)$ equals
questions.explanation: $\dfrac{8\pi}{5}=2\pi-\dfrac{2\pi}{5}$ and $\sin(2\pi-\theta)=-\sin\theta$, so principal value is $-\dfrac{2\pi}{5}$.

questions.prompt: The value of $\cot^{-1} 1 + \cot^{-1} 2 + \cot^{-1} 3$ is
If $x>0$, $y>0$, $xy<1$, and $\tan^{-1} x + \tan^{-1} y = \dfrac{\pi}{4}$, then
questions.explanation: Using tangent addition: $1=\tan(\pi/4)=\dfrac{x+y}{1-xy}$ so $x+y-xy=1$.

questions.prompt: If $\alpha = \sin^{-1}\dfrac{3}{5}$ (principal value), then $\tan\dfrac{\alpha}{2}$ equals
questions.explanation: With $\sin\alpha=3/5$, $\cos\alpha=4/5$. Then $\tan(\alpha/2)=\dfrac{\sin\alpha}{1+\cos\alpha}=(3/5)/(1+4/5)=1/3$.

questions.prompt: The domain of $f(x) = \sqrt{\dfrac{x-1}{2-x}} + \arcsin\!\left(\dfrac{2x}{1+x^2}\right) + \log(4-x)$ is
questions.explanation: Require (x-1)/(2-x)\ge0 => 1\le x<2; arcsin argument in [-1,1] always true; log(4-x) needs x<4. Intersection $[1,2)$.

questions.prompt: The range of $f(x) = \dfrac{x^2 - x + 1}{x^2 + x + 1}$ ($x \in \mathbb{R}$) is
questions.explanation: Set y=f(x) and require real x; discriminant condition yields $1/3\le y\le 3$.

questions.explanation: Integer part [x] solves t^2-3t-4=0 => t=4 or t=-1. So x\in[4,5)\cup[-1,0) — infinitely many real x.

questions.prompt: The number of onto functions from $A=\{1,2,3,4\}$ to $B=\{a,b,c\}$ is
questions.explanation: By inclusion–exclusion: $3^4-\binom{3}{1}2^4+\binom{3}{2}1^4=81-48+3=36$.

questions.prompt: Which of the following functions is periodic?
questions.explanation: Fractional part {x} has period 1 and {x/2} has period 2, so sum has period 2. The others are not periodic.

questions.prompt: Let $f(x) = \dfrac{e^x - 1}{e^x + 1}$. Then $f^{-1}(x)$ equals
questions.explanation: Solve y=(e^x-1)/(e^x+1): e^x=(1+y)/(1-y), so x=\dfrac{1}{2}\ln\dfrac{1+y}{1-y} with |y|<1.
